articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin closing out best quarter since 2024, ether its best since 2021
articles.snippet: Crypto prices rose early Wednesday after better-than-forecast inflation data, but gave up those gains as interest rates continued to surge.

articles.title: Winklevoss-owned Gemini switches Zcash software ahead of faster 25-second blocks
articles.snippet: The new Zakura nodes caught up with the network in just over six hours in Gemini’s deployments. The crypto exchange’s previous software took close to a day.

articles.title: Crypto advocacy group announces picks for US Congress as midterms loom
articles.snippet: The organization’s endorsements in the House and Senate came as many polls showed Democrats favored to regain control of both chambers in 2027.

articles.title: Base completes Cobalt upgrade, adds new tools for tokenized assets
articles.snippet: Base’s Cobalt lets traders set transaction conditions while giving issuers tools for compliance checks, stock splits and forced token transfers.

articles.title: Bloomberg brings onchain stablecoin data to its Terminal
articles.snippet: Bloomberg’s Allium-powered dashboard gives Terminal users hourly data on stablecoin supply, issuance, transfers and activity across blockchain networks.
